description: This file defines a RuntimeEstimator class for estimating GPU runtime of PyTorch operations using different models, including benchmarking and roofline cost modeling. It manages module execution order, runtime statistics, and integrates with PyTorch's FakeTensorMode for simulation.

classes.name: RuntimeEstimator
classes.description: A context manager class that estimates GPU runtime of PyTorch functions using different estimation methods, tracking module execution order and runtime statistics.

methods.name: _maybe_run_and_benchmark_fallback_kernel
methods.description: Runs and benchmarks a fallback kernel for a given function, measuring execution time on GPU.

methods.name: _benchmark_estimate
methods.description: Estimates function runtime using operator benchmarking.

methods.name: _roofline_estimate
methods.description: Estimates function runtime using a roofline cost model based on device FLOPs and bandwidth.

methods.name: display_modulewise_stats
methods.description: Displays collected module-wise runtime statistics and execution order.

methods.name: __torch_dispatch__
methods.description: Overrides tensor dispatch to estimate operation runtime and accumulate stats.

methods.name: __call__
methods.description: Sets the estimation mode (benchmark or roofline) for the RuntimeEstimator.

methods.name: __enter__
methods.description: Initializes and registers hooks for tracking module execution order and runtime statistics.

methods.name: __exit__
methods.description: Outputs the collected runtime statistics and cleans up hooks.
